body:

Changed OWNED files only:
- gpu/tests/metal_resource_integration_test.py: ABI gate now derives all sizes/offsets from Rust+C via abi_oracle; records resource 488 and derives four level arrays = Rust TEGU_AIR_COMPUTE_MAX_LEVELS (16), no handwritten size table. Adds D8F18H fixture provenance gate.
- workers/integration_tests/abi_oracle.py: array count probe from Rust field counts.
- n2mb_v2_job_test.c: TLS-only/WLS-only/mixed LOCAL_STORAGE through real bridge selector5/7 + fake JM, v9_pack unpack; word17/18 oversize refused; TLS/WLS handles present in submit and alive at WAIT, released after; forced post-allocation cmd failure releases locals/no submit. D8F18H real packet dispatch.
- n2mb_draw_v2_test.c: draw v3 FAU vertex/base (+ signed) and flat triangle TILER_CONTEXT, line+flat refusal.
- New d8f18h_pkg.h/json + regenerate_d8f18h_packet.py: final-742cdf3d D8F18H-linear1 SPIR-V 791bd8cc -> TGP2 a179cc46 (9920B TLS32), embedded and provenance-checked; 5 manifest records imported/dispatched through fake JM.

Coverage: TGP2 156, job166 release+ASan, draw33 release+ASan, Vk83 13, producer59, corpus no signal, render variant/legacy/native frontend/variant-thread gates. Flat-line gap I reported is fixed in 50cfaee; the suite now PASSES it. No hardware execution, pixels, descriptor acceptance, IOMMU/page-fault proof or app coverage. Shadow IOSurface remains mock; TSan not used; TLS BO 2048/core is bridge conservative bound, not device-proven; D8F18H wire is locally reconstructed for its real manifest, not an app-supplied runtime descriptor set; mips>1/>16 layers/atomics/exact sampler/render specialized compiler execution remain cross-owner. Candidate is source-locked to current receipt; if lowering L2 changes compiler after this post I will rerun --candidate and report the mismatch/failure rather than waive it.
